title: Science Theory Advancement Wave — 2026-09-12
purpose: Record concrete theory work performed after the 2026-09-11 rigor matrix and the 2026-09-12 equation guide. The wave prioritizes calculations that close an explicit gap rather than adding terminology.
selection_rule: Choose high-value branches where the archive already identified one missing mathematical decision and where that decision can be advanced without inventing experimental evidence.
